name: Seasons
overview: Scripture reveals that God has established seasons as part of His divine order, marked by celestial lights to separate times for various purposes, including days, years, and seasons (Genesis 1:14). These changing seasons—such as seedtime and harvest, summer and winter—are continual and purposeful, sustaining the earth and its inhabitants (Genesis 8:22; Isaiah 55:10). The Bible also teaches that every event and activity has its appointed season, reflecting God's sovereign timing and providence (Ecclesiastes 3:1), and that those who live in harmony with God's timing will prosper, like trees bearing fruit in their proper season (Psalms 1:3).
